title: Support that knows every account
description: Connect customer context, request handling, escalation, onboarding, health, and recurring learning across the tools where customer work happens.
introduction: Customer work rarely lives in one ticket. The answer may depend on a help article, an account promise, a product issue, a recent meeting, or a message from the team. The same context matters after the ticket closes, when Customer Success needs to know whether the customer is getting value.

Strawberry can work across those sources in the browser and apps your team already uses. Your companion can open the current records, follow the history across logged-in tools, and carry the account goals, terminology, and response preferences your team agrees on into the next customer interaction.

sections.title: What Strawberry can help you do

items.title: Understand the customer
items.description: Bring goals, history, product use, support experience, and open commitments into one view.

items.title: Respond and resolve
items.description: Triage requests, find reliable answers, and make the next move clear.

items.title: Coordinate and escalate
items.description: Give the right team the impact, evidence, and exact ask without losing the customer thread.

items.title: Help customers reach value
items.description: Turn agreed goals into onboarding, progress reviews, and useful customer conversations.

items.title: Learn and improve
items.description: Turn verified resolutions and recurring feedback into better docs and product insight.

blocks.text: Not sure where to begin? Your companion can look at the customer work you have open and suggest a useful Support or Success skill to try first.

skill.context: Start with the customer work already in front of you and choose the Support or Success workflow that would help most.

blocks.text: A ticket, usage report, CRM record, and meeting note can each tell a different story. Strawberry can bring the useful pieces together, show where they agree or conflict, and keep the sources close enough to inspect. That gives Support better context for the current request and Success a clearer view of whether the customer is getting value.

items.title: See whether the customer is getting value
items.text: Compare goals, product use, support experience, relationships, and open commitments without hiding uncertainty behind a score.

skill.context: Review the customer's progress, current signals, evidence gaps, and next actions.

items.title: Prepare for the next conversation
items.text: Bring the goals, history, open questions, and decisions into a short brief for a check-in, QBR, renewal, or escalation.

skill.context: Prepare for a customer conversation using the account context that could change it.

items.title: Carry the conversation into follow-through
items.text: Turn reliable notes or a transcript into decisions, commitments, customer follow-up, and the next internal actions.

skill.context: Preserve the decisions, commitments, and follow-through from a customer conversation.

blocks.text: Good Support work starts with the customer's impact and the team's real policy. Strawberry can read the full thread, check support history and known issues, search current product and help content, and prepare the route or answer with the sources and dates still visible.

items.title: Triage the request
items.text: Assess impact and urgency, check for known context, and make the owner, next action, and first response clear.

skill.context: Triage this customer request using the team's actual rules and current context.

items.title: Research the answer
items.text: Reconcile product docs, help content, account history, prior cases, and current sources into a reliable customer response.

skill.context: Find the strongest available answer and prepare a response for this customer and channel.

blocks.text: When another team needs to act, Strawberry can turn the customer history into a concise escalation with the impact, timeline, work already tried, current communication, and exact ask. The handoff keeps the customer relationship with Support or Success while the specialist team owns its part of the investigation.

items.title: Give the next team an actionable brief
items.text: Package the customer impact and the specific investigation, decision, or exception the receiving team needs to own.

skill.context: Prepare the customer-impact brief, current communication, exact internal ask, and next owner.

items.title: Turn a product problem into an engineering issue
items.text: Reproduce the problem, inspect the technical context, check for duplicates, and prepare a grounded issue record.

skill.context: Research and report the product bug while keeping customer-specific context appropriately scoped.

items.title: Keep cross-team follow-through visible
items.text: Track the owner, next update, unresolved decision, and verified resolution across the systems involved.

skill.context: Track the owners and unresolved commitments behind a customer escalation.

blocks.text: Customer Success begins with the outcome the customer expects, not a generic product tour. Strawberry can reconcile the signed scope, sales notes, meetings, account records, setup dependencies, stakeholders, and success measures into a practical path to first value.

items.context: Turn agreed goals and commitments into an owned path to first value.

blocks.text: A verified resolution can improve the help center; a pattern across tickets and conversations can become product insight. These are different jobs. One helps the next customer solve the problem. The other helps Product see recurring themes, tensions, examples, and gaps without automatically deciding the roadmap.

items.title: Make the answer reusable
items.text: Turn a verified resolution or recurring question into clear, findable customer documentation without creating a duplicate article.

skill.context: Turn verified current behavior into clear, findable customer documentation.

items.title: Show Product what customers are telling you
items.text: Synthesize the customer feedback your team can use into themes and gaps, with links back to the original examples.

skill.context: Turn customer feedback into themes, tensions, examples, and gaps with clear links to the sources.

blocks.text: A useful Support or Success method should not live with one person. Once the team trusts a workflow, Strawberry can preserve the sources, customer context, tone, routing, ownership, and review points behind it.

items.context: Turn a trusted customer workflow into a shared team method with clear context, ownership, review points, and stop conditions.

blocks.text: Share the reviewed result when teammates only need the answer, brief, or account plan. Save the method as a team skill when they should follow the same process. Add a Routine only after the trigger, owner, review behavior, and stop conditions are stable.
